question: Should the POC intercept real system-wide HTTPS traffic, or is a self-contained demo feed plus a real HTTP composer enough for learning?
probes: A capture of Proxyman's certificate/proxy setup screen
resolution: Still open; no capture of the original's certificate/proxy setup was available. System-wide HTTPS interception is not installed, so other apps are not captured yet. This is a scope estimate, not a match to the original.
